Name: Frame-Asynchronous Metadata Wrapper TRE
Description: The Frame-Asynchronous Metadata Wrapper allows the data producer to indicate that a set of TREs are frame-asynchronous metadata. Frame-asynchronous metadata is metadata that is tied to a specific point or period of time in the collection. Frame-asynchronous metadata may be placed in a NITF File Header or NITF Image Segment Subheader depending on the scope of the metadata being wrapped. If the FASYWA TRE is placed in a NITF Image Segment Subheader, it is recommended that the NITF Image Segment represent a temporal block that includes the period of time associated with the FASYWA TRE if possible. If the FASYWA TRE is placed in a NITF File Header, it is recommended that the NITF file represent a time interval that includes the period of time associated with the FASYWA TRE if possible.

START_TIMESTAMP.Name: Starting timestamp associated with the encapsulated NTF TREs
START_TIMESTAMP.Description: This field shall indicate the starting timestamp associated with the encapsulated NITF TREs.

END_TIMESTAMP.Name: Ending timestamp associated with the encapsulated NITF TREs
END_TIMESTAMP.Description: This field shall indicate the ending timestamp associated with the encapsulated NITF TREs.

CD_RETAG.Name: CE_RETAG of the nth encapsulated NITF TRE
CD_RETAG.Description: This field repeats once for each encapsulated TRE. The number of TREs is not signaled and is determined by parsing the TRE data.

CE_REL.Name: Length Field of the nth Encapsulated NITF TRE
CE_REL.Description: This field repeats once for each encapsulated TRE. The value 99,950 is the maximum TRE length possible. This may only be achieved if there is a single encapsulated TRE. The number of TREs is not signaled and is determined by parsing the TRE data.

CE_REDATA.Name: Data of the nth Encapsulated NITF TRE
CE_REDATA.Description: This field shall contain the data of the nth encapsulated NITF TRE.
